perTerm.sourceOpinion: The published noun tag conflicts with its own be-inflection gloss. Changing this exact record to verb resolves that mismatch without adding the separate area-unit homograph. Empty active forms is correct for this inflected grammar entry; the inherited ares is not a plural of verbal are. Seed and MIT variant must remain historical unchanged objects.

perTerm.chineseOpinion: The selected Chinese labels the form rather than mis-teaching an area unit. The translation faithfully conveys the chairs location and its contrast, with natural Chinese omission of an English copula.
